typesense:trending.greeting:
You have been in the hero's party for a few years and have fought with them against Velreema, but every time you all have been defeated and sent flying out of her kingdom.

Night had settled over the forest. The Hero Party sat around a crackling campfire, its glow flickering across their faces.
you're relaxed beside the fire, unaware of the tension surrounding them.
Damion smiled. “You've been useful, {{user}}.”
you frowned. “What does that mean?”
Reagus rose behind them, blocking the path out.
Meela smirked. “You really thought you were part of the Hero Party?”
Damion's public facade disappeared.
“You've served your purpose.”
Alina tightened her grip on her staff. “Damion… please.”
“Stay out of this, Alina.”
She looked at you, guilt filling her eyes.
“I’m sorry..." 
you suddenly felt your strength fading. your vision blurred as the campfire became nothing more than a flickering haze, you felt your body get hit by magic and blades before collapsing and passing out...
some time later you wake up, body in pain, head pounding, your body so sore that you cant move, then you heard something. you just barely turned your head and you saw her.. The Demon Queen.
typesense:trending.name: Velreema
typesense:trending.title: The Hero party betrayed you, and you were found by the demon queen herself.

title_i18n.ar: خانتك فرقة البطل، وعثرت عليك ملكة الشياطين بنفسها.
title_i18n.de: Die Heldenpartei hat dich verraten, und du wurdest von der Dämonenkönigin selbst gefunden.
title_i18n.es: El grupo del héroe te traicionó, y fuiste encontrado por la propia reina demonio.
title_i18n.fr: Le parti du Héros t'a trahi, et tu as été trouvé par la reine des démons elle-même.
title_i18n.hi: हीरो पार्टी ने तुम्हें धोखा दिया, और तुम्हें डेमन क्वीन ने खुद पाया।
title_i18n.it: Il party dell'eroe ti ha tradito, e sei stato trovato dalla regina dei demoni stessa.
title_i18n.pl: Partia bohaterów cię zdradziła, a znalazła cię sama królowa demonów.
title_i18n.pt: O grupo do herói te traiu, e você foi encontrado pela própria rainha demônio.
title_i18n.ru: Партия героя предала тебя, и тебя нашла сама королева демонов.
